articles.title: VM Not Starting - Initial Recovery Runbook
articles.solution_summary: Triage and recover an Azure VM that fails to boot or start
steps: Check Azure Service Health for regional compute incidents
Verify VM power state and recent activity logs
Open Boot Diagnostics and capture screenshot and serial logs
Validate disk health and OS disk attachment
Run Azure VM Repair extension or serial console checks
If still failing, restore from latest snapshot or backup

articles.title: NSG Blocking Application Traffic
articles.solution_summary: Diagnose and resolve inbound or outbound traffic blocked by NSG rules
steps: Identify source and destination IPs, ports, and protocol
Inspect effective security rules on NIC and subnet
Check rule priority conflicts and deny-all behavior
Create least-privilege allow rule with proper priority
Validate with Network Watcher IP flow verify
Monitor flow logs to confirm traffic is allowed

articles.title: Storage Account Access Denied (403)
articles.solution_summary: Resolve storage access denied errors caused by auth, RBAC, or firewall constraints
steps: Validate whether request uses Entra ID, account key, or SAS
Check RBAC role assignments at correct scope
Review storage firewall and private endpoint configuration
Regenerate SAS token if expired or missing permissions
Retest with Azure Storage Explorer or CLI
Enable diagnostic logs for failed authorization events

articles.title: Managed Identity or RBAC Permission Denied
articles.solution_summary: Fix authorization failures for managed identities and service principals
steps: Confirm identity object ID and tenant context
Review role assignments at resource, group, and subscription scope
Assign least-privilege built-in role required for action
Wait for propagation and refresh tokens
Retest operation and capture correlation ID
For Key Vault, verify access policy or RBAC mode

articles.title: AKS Pod CrashLoopBackOff Remediation
articles.solution_summary: Stabilize AKS workloads that are repeatedly crashing
steps: Get pod events and previous container logs
Check image pull errors and registry permissions
Validate CPU and memory limits against real usage
Inspect readiness and liveness probes
Check node pressure, autoscaler status, and taints
Roll out fixed deployment and monitor restart count

articles.title: Unexpected Azure Cost Spike Investigation
articles.solution_summary: Investigate sudden cost increase and identify optimization actions
steps: Use Cost Analysis to isolate subscription, service, and region deltas
Identify top cost drivers by tag, resource group, and meter
Check for new deployments, scale changes, and unattached disks
Set or update budget alerts and anomaly alerts
Recommend right-sizing, reservations, or shutdown schedules
Document owner actions and expected monthly savings

articles.title: Azure Monitor Alert Not Firing
articles.solution_summary: Diagnose alert rules that fail to trigger or notify
steps: Verify signal type and target resource scope
Check alert condition threshold and aggregation period
Validate action group configuration and receiver health
Confirm diagnostic settings send data to workspace
Run KQL query for expected signal data in timeframe
Adjust rule sensitivity and retest with synthetic event

articles.title: ARM/Bicep Deployment Failed
articles.solution_summary: Resolve infrastructure deployment failures in ARM or Bicep workflows
steps: Capture deployment operation details and top error code
Validate template syntax and parameter values
Check resource provider registration and region availability
Verify identity permissions for all target resources
Re-run deployment in what-if mode for drift preview
Apply corrected template and monitor rollout
